title: Sinhala & English Data Entry
description: I need a batch of Sinhala and English text transferred into Word (and occasionally Excel) with each section laid out as clean, reader-friendly, formatted paragraphs. The source material is already scanned or supplied as images, so this is pure text data entry rather than transcription or translation. Key points: • Document type: Data Entry in Excel/Word • Content: Text data only, no numeric tables • Layout: Final files must use properly indented, consistently styled paragraphs You will be switching between FM Abhaya, Unicode, Wijesekara and a standard English keyboard, so fluency in both scripts is essential. Accuracy is non-negotiable—spelling, punctuation and line breaks must mirror the originals exactly. A typing speed of around 50 WPM or higher will make the timeline comfortable; same-day turnaround is ideal for smaller batches. Deliverables 1. Word document (or Excel sheet where specified) with the full text, paragraph-formatted and proof-checked 2. A quick status note confirming you have compared against the source page-by-page If everything looks clear, send a brief confirmation and I’ll forward the first set of pages right away.
